recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在粉紅色對比染色背景中，可見許多深藍黑色的陽性細胞核，大小不一，包括數個大型、形狀不規則的非典型細胞核；EBV 陽性大型 B 細胞是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的診斷關鍵。
features: Numerous nuclei with dark blue-black EBER signal on a pink (nuclear fast red) counterstain
EBER-positive cells vary in size, including large atypical cells with irregular, multilobated nuclei
Background of EBER-negative cells with pale cytoplasm and necrotic-appearing matrix
describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) shows numerous positive nuclei of variable size, including large atypical cells with irregular nuclear contours, set in a background of EBER-negative cells. The density of positive cells appears high in this field, although formal counting per high-power field is not possible from a single image. Findings support an EBV-driven B-cell lymphoproliferation and, with the angiocentric pattern and CD20 staining, are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, likely of higher grade.

ddx.vs: Both are EBER-positive and angiocentric, but in ENKTL the EBER-positive cells coexpress CD56 and cytoplasmic CD3 rather than CD20.
EBVMCU is a sharply circumscribed superficial ulcer in immunosuppressed patients, not a multifocal angiodestructive lung-based process.
EBER-positive cells in CHL are CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with weak or absent CD20 and PAX5-dim staining.
